reason: This looks central and risk-bearing enough for a focused deep review. Even though the stated goal is a data-race fix, it touches `SessionVars.Status`, which is a core session/protocol state carrier, and the changed paths span `session`, `sessionctx`, `executor`, and planner-adjacent code. A race fix here often means changing how status flags are read/written or synchronized, which can hide High-severity regressions in transaction/session status semantics, protocol-visible server-status bits, or session-state encode/decode behavior. The cross-cutting file set is too central to treat as a routine local fix.
